verdict.rationale: Scheduled or background automation, such as drift-detection runs, is a fair question for an infrastructure-as-code tool, so the axis applies. However, the evidence shows only interactive CLI commands (plan, apply with saved plans, test, import). The 'Automate your development workflow' line refers to managing GitHub resources as code, not to autonomous background execution. Running OpenTofu from external CI or schedulers would be a user-side or host-platform workaround and earns no credit.
